This may be an unconventional answer but Albion Online is promising to put a lot of effort into the farming section of their game and from what I've seen the farming looks pretty cool.

Other reasons it might interest you:

-You don't have to Pvp at all, farming takes place on a private island.

-...but if you get bored of farming you can go kill mobs for silver or gather resources or craft stuff.

-You can sell what you farm to other players, complete with a changing economy which will make choice of crops interesting

-You'll make friends because good farmers will be valuable to guilds.

-You can play it on tablets (android or iOS) or whatever platform you're on (Win/Lin/Mac).

-the art style is beautiful albeit very simple.

Video highlighting farming in the game: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_qb8Q8JY2dc

Downside: It's still in alpha, although a summer alpha test is happening right now. It might be a bit before the game is officially released, but once it is, it will be free to play.
